reason: The plugin is primarily an agent testing/debugging utility: it freezes a completed DSH turn as baseline, runs a single approved candidate session, and compares baseline/candidate results via an explicit scorecard of request-surface evidence and execution metrics. Evidence in the readme and manifest shows web UI integration, replay control flow, and isolated workspace execution, so it is best classified as a testing/debugging workbench rather than a general-purpose tooling or communication plugin.

summaries.zh: Replay Lab 是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件，用于冻结已完成会话回合后重放候选方案并对比请求面、轨迹和执行指标，帮助做回归和行为复现排查。
summaries.en: Replay Lab is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that replays a completed session turn with selected candidates and compares request-surface evidence, trajectory, and execution metrics to support regression debugging.

capabilities: Replays completed DeepSeek Harness turns under selected preset or plugin candidates
Compares baseline and candidate runs with recorded execution metrics and request-surface evidence
Captures provenance such as request-related hashes and workspace state for controlled comparisons
Runs candidate sessions in isolated workspace copies with drift tracking
